To aid the development and implementation of a currency model for IAPT services that is predicated upon the delivery of outcomes related to treatment that are captured within the IAPT dataset.
• Proving that this currency model:
o Rewards good performance
o Incentivises performance improvement
o Minimises perverse incentives
o Is stable over time
• Proving that data completeness is maturing to the required level
Showing that performance is converging over time

Processing activities: 
Economic modelling (retrospective): allow for the iterative refinement of currency model against both retrospective and continuing flows of data
Road Test – Implementation as Shadow Currency: Allow for the review of service performance in light of currency model.

Specific outputs expected, including target date(s): 
• Currency available for use with local prices;
• Mandatory currency with local prices;
• National tariff with local adjustments as required (when it is proven that costs & performance have converged sufficiently)

Expected measurable benefits to health and/or social care, including target date(s): 
The benefits of developing a PBR currency for IAPT services are that, when deployed, it will drive up quality in a number of outcome measures. These include clinical, access and patient experience outcomes. The currency can also be used to drive operational efficiencies, reducing costs. 
Other benefits include enabling the principle of the money following the patient, which is a key enabler of the policy of attaining parity between mental health and physical health. This can only be achieved by an appropriate balance of resources.
